explained.summary: It’s shameful that your face obeys your mind, putting on whatever expression you choose, while your mind won’t order and compose itself. Marcus is pointing at the oddity of controlling your outward look while letting your inner state run wild.
explained.today: Most of us can smile politely through a tense meeting. The harder, more useful skill is calming the irritation underneath, not just hiding it behind a pleasant face.
